title: Scene Graph Contrastive Learning for Embodied Navigation
caption: Figure 2: Iterative Graph Building. Illustrative example of how a scene graph is built. The agent, the room, and the objects are all added as nodes to the graph. As the agent moves in the environment, we add the objects that it sees, for instance at t=3, the coffee machine, sink, and counter- top. We also add edges that signify various relationships like Contains, On, and Sees.
